skillFull: Curls up and rolls ahead at given intervals. On the way back Bear Jellies are impaled by the pins on its back, which then are returned to the Cookie. Level Up for more points for Pinned Bear Jellies.
story: Born without spines, Black Pinnypine desperately wanted to become spiky and had decided needles were the best option. One day, while hiding out in the Crown Punky workshop, waiting alertly for the chance to strike, Black Pinnypine saw a sewing pin gleaming in the moonlight and immediately fell in love. It was precisely that moment when Currant Cream Cookie, who had been up all night working, sleepily mistook the small pet for a pin cushion that Black Pinnypine rushed to the opportunity. The small creature curled up into the shape of a pin cushion, waiting to be spike-ified. While not a bad idea, what about the prick of the needle?!

costumes.name: Crown Punky's Mascot Crown Punky's Mascot
costumes.info:
"A mascot should encompass the very essence of a brand, and Black Pinnypine's hat is the perfect example of this. Decorated with buckles and skulls; all it needs is a cherry on top! A bit over-kill, you say? Try asking Crown Punky fans! Minimalism is out, Punky maximalism is all the rage!"
- Cogue Magazine

costumes.name: Meow Meow
costumes.info: Wearing a cat hat crafted from spare cloth hidden among the overflowing pules of fabrics, Black Pinnypine took on an unusual demeanor. It sits by the window on moonlit nights, meowing as if casting a spell, transforming Cookies, who has touched the pins, into cats!
